item.description:
Kipowi 0.7.0

  • Cut a section out of a clip: mark in and out, press Cut out, and it is gone. The timeline shortens, playback skips it, and ⌘Z puts it back.
  • Plays VP9 and AV1 video in ordinary .mp4 files — the kind YouTube downloaders write, which QuickTime refuses.
  • Open a spritesheet and watch it play. Kipowi works out the grid, shows it over the sheet to check, and plays the frames while you pick the rate.
  • Save writes your changes back into the picture you opened, replacing it. It asks first, and undo then save again puts it back.
  • Export a picture at an exact size, with presets for the Mac App Store, video, cinema, social and paper. Each says whether it fits your crop or what it would trim.
  • Hold ⇧ while dragging a crop handle to keep its shape, and 16:10 joins the aspect presets.
  • Fixed: an M4A audio export was named .mp4 when you typed the filename yourself.
